title: Narrative Backlog
description: Phase 27's pending_actions retry-queue table has not landed yet as of this dashboard's build (2026-07-31) — the 'Pending Actions Queue Depth' panel below uses a defensive to_regclass() check so it renders 0 gracefully instead of erroring until that table exists; no schema from Phase 27 is assumed or depended on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS open_threads FROM narrative_threads WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
SELECT count(*) AS open_action_items FROM action_items WHERE status IN ('open', 'overdue')
SELECT count(*) AS pending_approvals FROM pending_approvals WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT count(*) AS pending_reactions FROM pending_reactions WHERE status = 'pending'

panels.title: Pending Actions Queue Depth (Phase 27, not yet built)
panels.description: Placeholder: returns 0 until Phase 27's pending_actions table exists. Uses to_regclass() so this panel never errors regardless of whether that table has landed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.pending_actions') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM pending_actions WHERE status IN ('pending', 'retrying')) END AS pending_actions_queue_depth
SELECT id, topic, department, status, updated_at FROM narrative_threads WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50
